cards.title: The Last Putt

story_engine.scene: Charity hospitality hides a returning rival's intent: Duckhook invited ObiWan, who won the same Week9 pairing in 2025.
story_engine.tension: Duckhook defends a one-game Wings lead; ObiWan is tied atop Burgers on W-L. Neither loss is a mathematical elimination.
story_engine.mechanism: Move from relaxed first tee to alternating approach/bunker/putt detail panels and a water-side deciding green. Physical golf events remain fiction.
story_engine.turn: A visible downslope beyond the green makes an overhit ball reaching water legible; never make a flat short putt magically leap into the pond.

cards.physical_direction: Keep the common opening result-neutral; outcome edit assigns the strongest/poorest montage shots. No lightsaber attacks, Force intervention or unrequested dog distraction.
cards.emotional_consequence: Play the loser's silence and slumped shoulders against the beautiful sunrise; winner succeeds at golf, not magic.
cards.draft_opening_copy: The invitation said charity. Neither man arrived feeling charitable about losing.
cards.home_win: Duckhook wins: ObiWan makes an increasingly embarrassing series of poor golf shots; Duckhook controls his course and wins; visibly anguished ObiWan
cards.away_win: ObiWan wins: Duckhook misses embarrassing decisive putt/approach toward the water hazard while ObiWan finishes steadily; defeated Duckhook registers the blow

cards.title: No Easy Way Out

story_engine.scene: Mud Dogs tears into his home-swamp endurance course, sees the storm, and chooses to keep racing.
story_engine.tension: A 2–6 team needs a recovery; El Niño enters 4–4 in the playoff chase. Treat the spoiler characterization as Commissioner narrative, not proof Niño has no playoff chance.
story_engine.mechanism: Return to three course anchors: raised start bank, channel crossing, finish on firmer ground. Rising water changes those same spaces.
story_engine.turn: The narrow raised route that seemed slower becomes the only finishable line; a late choice determines extraction versus a buried rear wheel.

cards.physical_direction: No second rider impersonates El Niño. Storm pressure, flood direction and wheel contact communicate the opponent.
cards.emotional_consequence: If Mud loses, the finish remains visible but unreachable; if Mud wins, show exhausted skill, not a miraculous dry reset.
cards.draft_opening_copy: He knew every turn in the swamp. By the next lap, the swamp had moved them.
cards.home_win: Mud Dogs wins: masters underwater/muddy line and finishes the race through a final hazard
cards.away_win: El Niño wins: Mud Dogs' bike becomes embedded/sucked into deep water and mud and cannot finish; storm physically wins by obstructing race

cards.title: The Red Card

story_engine.scene: A lifted truck ploughs through the soccer terrace as Red looks on. Chins treats a treasured pitch as an off-road playground.
story_engine.tension: Red entered at 4–4 and seventh in the captured seeding; Chins is tied at 5–3 atop Pizza.
story_engine.mechanism: Tire marks cross the center circle; Red climbs a low terrace to intercept the truck at its slow turn, then tries to force it into a stone-service bottleneck.
story_engine.turn: Whether Chins clears that turn or becomes wedged decides the action. Loose goal netting tangles over the cab visually; stone geometry, not a flimsy net, bears the stopping force.

cards.physical_direction: Retaliation A+B selected under delegation. Keep any red-card joke as punctuation, not dialogue in place of the pounce.
cards.emotional_consequence: Red win: driver stopped and territorial dignity reclaimed. Chins win: Red thrown into muddy turf, ruined field foreground, truck intact beyond. No fatalities or permanent destruction asserted.
cards.draft_opening_copy: The first tire track cut through the center circle. The second crossed a line Red actually cared about.
cards.home_win: Red Leopards wins: ambush atop truck and spatial trap at the pitch/ruins stop Chins; home territory reclaimed
cards.away_win: Seven Deadly Chins wins: truck and driver physically overpower Red's ambush and keep churning across already damaged field; Red's heartbreak clear

cards.title: Served Cold

story_engine.scene: Chili hosts the town cookout; the hooded Belt Keeper steps into a crowd expecting the Outlaw's show.
story_engine.tension: The documented 2025 sample gives HMB two victories; Chili wants one public event to end on his terms. No invented all-time dominance.
story_engine.mechanism: Place a cool serving vat, prize ribbon and Dark Horse on a visible staging plan. A judging-table contest, not a royal court, drives the scene.
story_engine.turn: Chili win: his deliberate serving-cart maneuver spills chili across HMB; Dark Horse helps move the cart, with cooled food and no burn gag. HMB win: he effortlessly pulls the host's serving table into his own position, takes the cookout ribbon and leaves Chili holding the ladle as his server.

cards.physical_direction: Do not redesign HMB as a crowned monarch or replace his hood/black armor. A festival ribbon is never the league championship belt.
cards.emotional_consequence: Chili win: stunned red-eyed champion drenched in chili. HMB win: motionless champion eating while the furious host must serve at his own cookout.
cards.draft_opening_copy: Chili had invited the whole town to watch him cook. The Belt Keeper had come to see who would be served.
cards.home_win: Chili deliberately stages the cooled-chili serving-cart reversal; HMB is covered while retaining hood, armor and belt.
cards.away_win: HMB takes over the cookout judging table and ribbon; Chili is left ladle-in-hand serving the unruffled champion. No crown or belt transfer.

cards.title: The Highland Challenge

story_engine.scene: DK enters his home arena; the LLC answers in tailored, luxurious knight armor while preserving his face and corporate identity.
story_engine.tension: DK enters 4–4 after a 92.75-point Week8 defeat; LLC enters 3–5 after beating Red by 2.78. These are prior-week facts, not Week9 performance.
story_engine.mechanism: Arena wide -> clean clash -> pivot -> counter -> domination. Keep all four DK legs readable in at least one action-wide and the final spatial resolution.
story_engine.turn: DK win: powerful advancing parry breaks LLC's balance. LLC win: economical sidestep and shield leverage beats DK's turn. Show cause before kneeling defeat.

cards.physical_direction: No film still has been verified in this continuation; Gladiator is an aesthetic request, not a claimed shot-specific reference. No tigers, extra combatants or new copied film plot.
cards.emotional_consequence: Winner physically controls the ring; loser is defeated, not executed. No fantasy title awarded by this bout.
cards.draft_opening_copy: The stronghold knew its champion's entrance. It had not yet learned the challenger's price.
cards.home_win: D0nkey wins: Arsenal gorilla-centaur physically overpowers LLC and wins the sword fight
cards.away_win: The LLC wins: armored corporate knight outmaneuvers and physically overpowers the centaur champion

cards.title: Paint the Pressure

story_engine.scene: Slob and TDS start opposite a foothill speedball course whose inflatable cover is nested among trees and slopes.
story_engine.tension: Both enter 4–4; Slob chases the Wings leader while TDS shares the Burgers W-L lead. The recent 2024–25 sample favored TDS.
story_engine.mechanism: Breakout sprint -> snapshot around cover -> reciprocal flank -> low slide -> paint impact. Keep a common left/right course map and safe spectators outside active lanes.
story_engine.turn: The winner slides to an open firing angle; camera remains just behind the winner with the loser clearly downrange. Bright fresh paint breaks across mask and chest.

cards.physical_direction: One marker per character; safe protection stays on. TDS has exactly three protected serpent heads on one body; no duplicate bodies. Slob's horns/build remain recognizable.
cards.emotional_consequence: The winner's movement and loser's paint hits appear in the same decisive frame. No blood or real-firearm imagery.
cards.draft_opening_copy: At four and four, standing still was not a strategy. Neither of them did.
cards.home_win: Slob wins: final third-person winner-shoulder slide/aim shows TDS fully struck by multiple paint splatters
cards.away_win: Three Dreaded Snake wins: final third-person winner-shoulder slide/aim shows Slob hit by multiple paint splatters
